name: @msout/api
description: Public API: session state, pool manager, SSE hub, credential forwarder, CORS/CSRF, rate limits. No Docker socket, no vault mount, no egress.

engines.comment: 22.13.0 is the floor for node:sqlite, which is the api's database driver. The module was added in 22.5.0 but stayed behind --experimental-sqlite until 22.13.0, so an earlier floor produces a runtime that cannot load its own database driver. A native addon (better-sqlite3) would instead mean a compilation step and a prebuilt-binary supply chain in the component that must not have either. CI asserts this with `node -e "require('node:sqlite')"`, which is how the 22.5.0 floor was caught being wrong.

devDependenciesComment: @msout/microsoft-webauth is a devDependency, and only for one thing: tests/login-failures.test.ts imports its exported LOGIN_REASONS, so this api's transcription of that union is checked against the real one instead of drifting from it. It is deliberately not a runtime dependency. This api never loads Playwright, and pulling the package in to obtain an array of thirteen strings would put a browser-sized dependency tree in the component that must not have one - the runner owns Playwright, not the api. A test may depend on it; the service may not. See src/login-failures.ts.
